image_description: A full suit of Japanese-style armor (O-yoroi or similar) displayed on a stand. The armor features a helmet (kabuto) with a face mask (menpo), layered lacquered plates (sode/kote), and a torso section composed of small, laced scales (kozane) rather than a single solid plate. The color scheme is predominantly black lacquer with gold accents and red fabric lining/underlayers.
